purpose: Draw a TikZ figure. Image pixels: origin top-left, y down; convert with y_tikz = -y_px (or 396 - y_px, keep consistent), scale so 1 unit = 1/100 cm is fine. Points (px): A(67,65), M(162,65), B(446,65)

result.summary: Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (v1) of the figure with points A, M, B, C, D, E, F at measured pixel coordinates. It includes the solid top line A-M-B, diagonals A-C and B-D, a dashed M-C segment with a solid C-E segment, the solid D-F and E-F edges, and the right-angle mark at M. All seven labels are present. The Critic scored it 0.9 with must_repair=false and topology passing.
